blaze__root.title: Firebolt
blaze__root.description: Unlocks Firebolt (Level 3) (11 mana, 2.99 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
blaze__root.extra_description: Shoot a small projectile of fire, igniting whatever it hits. The first skill of the Blaze base.

blaze__fire_breath.title: Fire Breath
blaze__fire_breath.description: Unlocks Fire Breath (Level 3) (5 mana, 17.96 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
blaze__fire_breath.extra_description: Hold to spew a cone of fire outwards, igniting creatures and blocks in its path.

blaze__hasty_casting.title: Hasty Casting
blaze__hasty_casting.description: Teaches Hasty Casting, an Epic Fight Mobility skill: Spells take half as long to cast, and much faster movement while casting. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

blaze__demolition_leap.title: Demolition Leap
blaze__demolition_leap.description: Teaches Demolition Leap, an Epic Fight Mobility skill: Charge up and launch yourself where you look; halves your next fall damage. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

blaze__planned_blaze_spirits.title: Summon Blaze Spirits
blaze__planned_blaze_spirits.description: Unlocks Summon Blaze Spirits (60 mana, 120 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
blaze__planned_blaze_spirits.extra_description: Summon allied blazes that shoot fire charges at your enemies.

blaze__magma_bomb.title: Magma Bomb
blaze__magma_bomb.description: Unlocks Magma Bomb (Level 3) (30 mana, 17.96 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
blaze__magma_bomb.extra_description: Launch a bomb made from magma, exploding on impact and leaving a field of fire where it lands

blaze__avatar_of_might.title: Avatar of Might
blaze__avatar_of_might.description: Teaches Avatar of Might, an Epic Fight Identity skill: Hold sneak for 2 s to release a shockwave that pushes enemies away and makes you briefly immune to stuns. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

blaze__blaze_storm.title: Blaze Storm
blaze__blaze_storm.description: Unlocks Blaze Storm (Level 3) (5 mana, 29.93 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
blaze__blaze_storm.extra_description: Hold to unleash a barrage of blaze fireballs, shooting rapidly but wildly in front of you and igniting any creatures or blocks hit.

blaze__heat_surge.title: Heat Surge
blaze__heat_surge.description: Unlocks Heat Surge (Level 3) (53 mana, 67.33 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
blaze__heat_surge.extra_description: Emanate a surge of fiery magic, igniting and rending creatures in a radius around you. Rended creatures have reduced armor.

blaze__fire_blast.title: Fire Blast
blaze__fire_blast.description: Unlocks Fire Blast (Level 3) (11 mana, 2.99 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
blaze__fire_blast.extra_description: Fire long-range compressed fire beams that can hit targets in front of you.

blaze__combustion.title: Combustion
blaze__combustion.description: Unlocks Combustion (Level 3) (76 mana, 59.85 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
blaze__combustion.extra_description: Applies Combustion to yourself, granting Fire Spell Power and Fire damage bonus for a certain period of time.

blaze__eruption.title: Eruption
blaze__eruption.description: Unlocks Eruption (Level 3) (76 mana, 22.44 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
blaze__eruption.extra_description: Aim at the ground to summon an eruption that deals area damage.

blaze__apocalyptic_burst.title: Apocalyptic Burst
blaze__apocalyptic_burst.description: Unlocks Apocalyptic Burst (Level 2) (91 mana, 89.78 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
blaze__apocalyptic_burst.extra_description: Charges and releases a devastating explosion with high area damage.

blaze__wellspring_1.title: Wellspring 1
blaze__wellspring_1.extra_description: Core bonus (every archetype has this spoke).

blaze__reserve_mana.title: Reserve Mana
blaze__reserve_mana.description: Teaches Reserve Mana, an Epic Fight Passive skill: Refills your mana at once when it drops below 10%. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

blaze__fire_orbs.title: Fire Orbs
blaze__fire_orbs.description: Unlocks Fire Orbs (Level 3) (30 mana, 14.96 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
blaze__fire_orbs.extra_description: Summons several flame orbs that fall from the sky and hit enemies.

blaze__fireball.extra_description: Manifest and throw a ball of fire, exploding and dealing massive damage on impact.

blaze__renewal_2.title: Renewal 2

blaze__rapid_chant.title: Rapid Chant
blaze__rapid_chant.description: Teaches Rapid Chant, an Epic Fight Passive skill: Much shorter cast times, and channelled spells last much longer. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

blaze__scorch.title: Scorch
blaze__scorch.description: Unlocks Scorch (Level 3) (45 mana, 17.96 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
blaze__scorch.extra_description: In a targeted area, erupt a scorch of fiery magic, damaging creatures in the zone and leaving a field of fire.

blaze__flaming_barrage.title: Flaming Barrage
blaze__flaming_barrage.description: Unlocks Flaming Barrage (Level 3) (68 mana, 22.44 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
blaze__flaming_barrage.extra_description: Repeatedly cast to shoot individual small fireballs, which home towards your cursor, or the creature your cursor is targeting.

blaze__firestorm_vortex.title: Firestorm Vortex
blaze__firestorm_vortex.description: Unlocks Firestorm Vortex (Level 3) (69 mana, 26.93 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
blaze__firestorm_vortex.extra_description: Summons a fiery vortex at the target point that pulls nearby enemies inward and scorches them over time.

blaze__meteor_storm.title: Meteor Storm
blaze__meteor_storm.description: Unlocks Meteor Storm (Level 3) (83 mana, 134.66 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
blaze__meteor_storm.extra_description: Summons Ignis fireballs to rain down from the sky. If the caster's health falls below 50%, the fireballs transform into soul-fired projectiles.

blaze__wall_of_fire.title: Wall of Fire
blaze__wall_of_fire.description: Unlocks Wall of Fire (Level 3) (30 mana, 44.89 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
blaze__wall_of_fire.extra_description: Recast to place anchor points, which erupts into a wall of fire when the cast finishes, or when the maximum length is reached. This wall blocks projectiles and ignites creatures that pass through it.
